errors.text: The getter is proposed as excess Ti powder incorporated into the alloy rather than external titanium sponge; this would perturb the equiatomic composition and could introduce oxide inclusions.
The required quantitative regime is not reconstructed: hydrogen de-binding, vacuum below 3×10⁻⁶ torr, 1400°C for 18 hours, and water quenching from 1500°C are omitted.
No numerical grain-size prediction is supplied, despite the target result of 33 ± 19 µm.
